defect: The new merge timing calls timer.ElapsedNanos() unconditionally, which dereferences env_ although the new env parameter may be nullptr (StopWatchNano::ElapsedNanos calls env_->NowNanos()).
reason: The fix guards exactly these added RecordTick lines against a null env_, a null dereference that only exists because this change added the env-based timer; seeing it needs StopWatchNano and the callers that pass nullptr.

defect: UpdateResult's new alignment parameter is declared uint32_t while the handle stores alignment as size_t, so callers narrow size_t to uint32_t and clang's -Werror -Wshorten-64-to-32 build fails.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added parameter type to size_t to repair a clang compile failure, and the type mismatch with the size_t field is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix makes main return db_bench_tool's result instead of falling off the end of main.
reason: db_bench_tool always returns 0 (errors call exit(1)) and main implicitly returns 0, so the exit status was never wrong; the fix is a cleanup.

defect: The fix in this file only checks the Status of GetUniqueIdFromTableProperties and prints the file path before asserting.
reason: The crash the fix repairs comes from the header calling VerifyTableFileUniqueId for files that were not created; the change in this file only gains error reporting and behaves the same otherwise.

defect: RocksLuaCompactionFilter has no member to hold its name, so Name() (implemented in the .cc of the same change) returns c_str() of a local std::string, a heap use after free.
reason: The fix adds the mutable name_ member to this new class so Name() can return a pointer that outlives the call; the dangling pointer itself is in the .cc added by the same commit.

defect: The fix widens curtime to int64_t because DBWithTTL::GetCurrentTime writes an int64_t through an int32_t reference (stack overflow).
reason: GetCurrentTime's (int64_t*)&curtime cast and the int32_t curtime pattern in the merge operator existed before this change, which only copied the existing pattern into the new Merge.

defect: The fix deletes a stray unused debug function Blah() that this change left in the file.
reason: Blah() is dead code that neither breaks the build nor changes behaviour; removing it is a cleanup within an unused-variable PR.

defect: The fix moves the TickersNameMap and HistogramsNameMap definitions from the public header to a .cc file.
reason: Defining the const vectors in the header predates this change, which only reordered ticker entries; the fix is a refactor of that older design.

defect: The fix turns the header-defined const std::string kTraceMagic into an extern declaration defined in a .cc file.
reason: A const std::string at namespace scope has internal linkage, so each translation unit gets a correct copy; moving it is code hygiene, not a repair of wrong behaviour.

defect: GetUpdatesSince allocates probableWALFiles with new and returns early without deleting it when no WAL file matches, leaking the vector.
reason: The fix wraps exactly this new allocation in a unique_ptr to stop the leak on the early-return path, which this change introduced and which is visible in its diff.

defect: The fix changes the iterator to take ownership of the WAL file list through a unique_ptr so the caller in db_impl.cc no longer leaks it.
reason: The raw-pointer ownership of files_ predates this change and the leak sat on an early-return path in DBImpl::GetUpdatesSince, so this file only gets an ownership refactor.

defect: The fix replaces 'virtual ~ArenaWrappedDBIter()' with '~ArenaWrappedDBIter() override' to satisfy a lint rule.
reason: Style-only lint fix with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix removes a duplicated memtable_factory.reset line that a bad merge left in the CompactionTrigger test.
reason: The duplicate line only replaced the factory with an identical one; the fix is a test cleanup, not a repair of wrong behaviour.

defect: The fix iterates over all GetAllFixedImpls() entries instead of the hard-coded indices {0, 2, 3}, and frees leaked testers and readers.
reason: At this change GetAllFixedImpls() had four entries so indices 0, 2 and 3 were valid; the out-of-range came from the later renumbering in #10184, and the leaks were in unchanged lines.

defect: The fix makes the kVectorRep test configuration use VectorRepFactory(100) so the test exercises the vector rep initialization bug.
reason: The segfault was in the VectorRep implementation, not in this test file; the fix here is a test enhancement.

defect: RecordLevelNSlowdown adds micros to stall_leveln_slowdown_count_ instead of incrementing it, so the per-level stall count is wrong.
reason: The code this replaced in db_impl.cc incremented the count by one; this new file introduced '+= micros', which the fix changes to '++', and the mistake is visible next to the correct stall_counts_ increment.

defect: The assertion added to FilePickerMultiGet::ReplaceRange, 'curr_level_ == 0 || !RemainingOverlapInLevel()', can fail in valid states because the current file range is stale once the level search is done.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added assertion with 'hit_file_ == nullptr'; judging it requires the file picker's GetNextFileInLevel state handling outside the diff.

defect: The fix renames the test from Immortable to Immortal.
reason: Test-name typo fix with no behavioural effect.

defect: The fix makes the Transaction::MultiGet stress test cover deletes (Uniform(2) never chose op 2) and track expected values per key for duplicate keys.
reason: This change only replaced push_back with emplace_back and defaulted constructors; the Uniform(2) and duplicate-key logic predates it.

defect: In this change's lines the fix only re-wraps the std::find condition; the rest of the fix adds WaitForAddFile() for an AddFile/compaction conflict.
reason: The touched line from this change is reformatted only, and the AddFile conflict has nothing to do with the WAL recycle-list filtering added here.

defect: 'data->max = max();' assigns a uint64_t to the double HistogramData::max without a cast, which breaks the Windows (VS2015, warnings as errors) build.
reason: The fix adds a static_cast<double> to exactly this added line to repair a compile failure on a supported platform; the types are declared in the headers.

defect: The fix makes the CompressionLogTest.Fragmentation test use random data so it really spans several blocks after compression.
reason: This is a test-strength improvement; the test passed but covered less than intended, and no product code was wrong.

defect: Setting FaultInjectionTestFS to not direct-writable before DB open when write_fault_one_in is set lets the first WAL created during open be dropped on a crash, producing spurious verification failures.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added if/else with an unconditional SetFilesystemDirectWritable(true); seeing the data loss needs the fault-injection FS semantics and the later reconfiguration in RunStressTestImpl.

defect: TestCompactionListener::OnCompactionCompleted uses an old signature that does not match EventListener::OnCompactionCompleted(DB*, const CompactionJobInfo&), so it hides the virtual (clang -Werror build failure) and is never called.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added method to the base signature with override; the mismatch is only visible against include/rocksdb/listener.h.

defect: VerifyChecksumInBlocks now always reads through a FilePrefetchBuffer, which does not work with allow_mmap_reads and yields false checksum verification failures.
reason: The fix disables exactly this added prefetch buffer in mmap mode; knowing FilePrefetchBuffer is incompatible with mmap reads requires its implementation.

defect: The fix iterates headers_ by reference instead of by value in WriteHeaderInfo.
reason: Copying each header string is correct (c_str() is used within the iteration), so the change is only a minor efficiency cleanup; the real bug of the fix was in WinEnv::NowMicros.

defect: The fix adds a Windows delete command, uses std::vector and references, and stores newfname by value in LogHeaderTest.
reason: Binding the temporary string to a const reference extends its lifetime, so the test was correct; the rm -rf command predates this change and the rest is cleanup.

defect: Replacing the negated boost::starts_with(str, "0x") check with (str[0] == '0' && str[1] == 'x') inverts the condition, so HexToString rejects every valid hex input.
reason: The fix negates exactly this added condition, and the inversion is plain from the removed and added lines.

defect: The fix renames the non-thread-status stub from TimeToString(int64_t) to MicrosToString(uint64_t).
reason: At this change thread_status.h declared TimeToString, so the stub was correct; the later commit 248c063 renamed the API and broke this build configuration.

defect: The new WriteThreadWaitNanosCounter test calls POSIX sleep(2), which is not declared on Windows/MSVC, breaking the Windows test build (and making the test take 2 s).
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added sleep(2) with SystemClock::SleepForMicroseconds as part of repairing Windows build errors; using non-portable sleep() is visible in the diff.

defect: The range-tombstone iterators, which are heap-allocated rather than arena-allocated, are added to an arena MergeIteratorBuilder and held by ScopedArenaIterator, so they are never properly freed (TSAN/ASAN failure).
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added arena-based range-deletion iterator builders with non-arena merging iterators; the allocation mismatch is only visible from the iterator factories.

defect: The fix makes DBTest.DynamicMiscOptions check Snappy_Supported() instead of excluding only OS_WIN.
reason: The unconditional Snappy assertions predate this change and started failing because SetOptions now validates compression; the fix is a test adjustment.

defect: The fix takes the SuperVersion reference before reading the snapshot sequence in GetImpl to avoid a wrong result racing with flush.
reason: This change only added two sync points to expose the race; the ordering of snapshot and SuperVersion acquisition existed before.

defect: The fix in this file enables and splits the GetRaceFlush test and moves the ROCKSDB_LITE #endif.
reason: The fix repairs a Get()/flush race in db_impl.cc and updates tests; the compaction-conflict tests added by this change are not wrong.

defect: sorted_keys stores &key_context.back() while key_context is still growing, so once more than MAX_BATCH_SIZE (32) keys spill into the autovector's heap storage the stored pointers dangle and MultiGet crashes.
reason: The fix moves the pointer collection after key_context is fully built, repairing exactly this added line; taking pointers into a growing container is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix avoids an upper-bound comparison on every Next() when the current block is known to lie within the upper bound.
reason: The fix names #5289 as the origin of the perf regression; this change only moved the existing logic out of the template.

defect: The trivial-move path now adds moved files to c->level() + 1 instead of c->output_level(), placing files on the wrong level when the output level differs (e.g. dynamic level bytes or manual compaction to a target level).
reason: The removed line used c->output_level(); the fix restores output_level() in exactly these added lines, and the regression is visible in the diff.

defect: The new table_file_deletion event is logged before DeleteFile runs and regardless of its result, so the event log reports deletions that may have failed.
reason: The fix moves this added event after the deletion and records its status, which it calls a bug; the early unconditional logging is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix turns the FIXME repro test into a parameterized test that expects PrepareValue() to succeed after the db_iter fix.
reason: This change only added a test reproducing an existing DBIter bug; the fix updates that test after repairing the product code.

defect: AddFile allocates a new file number and copies the SST into the DB directory without registering the number in pending_outputs_ (and without holding the mutex), so a concurrent PurgeObsoleteFiles full scan can delete the file while it is being added.
reason: The fix adds CaptureCurrentFileNumberInPendingOutputs around exactly this added file-number allocation; the race needs knowledge of PurgeObsoleteFiles in another part of the code.
